category.description: The group the catalog lists the widget under

data.description: How Workspace reads and shows the data of this type

disableRetrievalForCopilot.description: Keeps the widget's data from the AI Agent; such a widget has no `mcp_tool`

params.description: The widget's parameters; an item that is a list of params is one row of the parameter bar

raw.description: The endpoint also answers `raw=true` with the rows the widget shows, as JSON: the AI Agent and MCP get those rows, and the widget's rows button shows them

refetchInterval.description: Fetch again every so many milliseconds, or on a 5-field cron schedule; false never

runButton.description: The widget fetches only when the user clicks Run

showTitle.description: false leaves the title off the widget
